scored.why: None of the findings reports submitting empty required fields and receiving no visible validation feedback; they concern labels, persistence, save-progress behavior, and stale confirmation.
Finding 1 reports that the Full name input has no persistent visible label after text is entered, matching placeholder-only inputs whose identification disappears once populated.
Finding 3 explicitly reports no saving-in-progress feedback and that Save changes remained enabled during the delayed save, matching the missing spinner/disabled state/message defect.

verifications.claim: Each profile input retains a visible persistent label after text replaces its placeholder.
verifications.evidence: After Full name was populated, step 19 explicitly observed that it contained Alice "with no persistent field label visible," disproving the requirement that every profile input remain identified. A re-check of this interaction did not reproduce the failure.

verifications.claim: All five saved settings (name, email, company, digest, and delivery notes) persist unchanged after reloading the account page.
verifications.evidence: Although step 7 still showed the saved values before a successful reload, step 9's fresh account-page observation showed all text fields empty and Email digest reset to Daily rather than Alice, alice@example.com, Acme, Weekly, and Leave at reception. A re-check of this interaction did not reproduce the failure.

verifications.claim: A valid save displays a visible confirmation that changes were saved after the required delay.
verifications.evidence: Steps 7 and 15 mention a successful/completed saved message, but the trace does not record an observation taken after waiting at least three seconds following submission.

verifications.claim: Immediately after a valid submission, the page visibly shows saving in progress or prevents another save.
verifications.evidence: The immediate-save inspection recorded in step 15 found an enabled Save changes button and an already completed saved message, rather than an in-progress indicator or disabled/prevented save. A re-check of this interaction did not reproduce the failure.

verifications.claim: Blank required fields and a malformed email each produce visible validation errors, and neither invalid submission shows a saved confirmation.
verifications.evidence: The trace records the blank and malformed-email submissions (steps 17 and 20) and notes no saved confirmation around the blank state, but it never records the validation messages/error state shown after either submission, so visible errors cannot be established.
